description: Phase 5 protocol: one-time evaluation of the selected model on the held-out test set. Fixed before the test set is opened.
fixed_on: 2026-11-27, before the test set is opened

amendment.name: C1b_generalization_with_test_noise
amendment.reason: The C1 interval reflects the uncertainty of the cross-validated score on 9,600 moons. The test score on 2,400 moons scatters about twice as widely, so a perfectly generalizing model would fall outside the C1 interval about one time in three.
amendment.criterion: The 95% interval of (test macro-F1 minus cross-validated macro-F1) includes 0.
amendment.method: 1,000 draws; each resamples the test predictions and the out-of-fold predictions independently and takes the difference of macro-F1.
amendment.status: supplementary; C1 is reported unchanged and strictly as defined

descriptive_analyses: all metrics of src/cv.py with bootstrap intervals, cross-validated versus test
seed luck: test macro-F1 of the selected model retrained with 5 other seeds
lifetime class on test, Random Forest with the same final settings
error map on a 6 x 6 grid of semi-major axis and inclination
test chaos twins (rule T5) and chaos-adjusted test accuracy

rule_T5.question: Do test errors concentrate on chaotic moons?
rule_T5.criterion: 95% bootstrap interval of (error rate on twin-disagreeing moons minus error rate on twin-agreeing moons) above 0

twins.run: after the test evaluation is committed

speed_benchmark.model_latency: feature computation plus prediction for one moon, single-threaded, median of 1,000 repetitions

outcome_handling.C1_and_C1b_pass: Generalization confirmed; test scores become the headline numbers.
outcome_handling.C1_fails_C1b_passes: Consistent with cross-validation within test-set noise; test scores reported as headline numbers with that wording.
outcome_handling.C1b_fails: Reported as overfitting or selection optimism; the gap is quantified; no model change.
outcome_handling.C2_fails: The surrogate is not shown to beat the physics rule out of sample; stated in the abstract.
outcome_handling.C3_fails: Miscalibration reported; no recalibration on test moons.
outcome_handling.T5_fails: Errors are not shown to concentrate on chaotic test moons; failure analysis focuses on the error map.

prediction_tool: src/predict.py uses the evaluated model (trained on the 9,600 training moons), not a model retrained on all 12,000 moons.
